verdict.rationale: Decagon lets operators configure and interact with the platform via natural language across multiple surfaces: defining agent behavior in AOPs 'the same way you train human agents with SOPs' (docs-16), Watchtower flagging criteria defined in plain language (docs-8, docs-20), and ad-hoc natural-language analytics queries like 'Why are customers requesting refunds?' (docs-9). This spans configuration, monitoring, and insights, indicating natural-language operation is a core design principle rather than a single feature. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that these natural-language interfaces work reliably in practice, and no evidence of a general-purpose natural-language command interface for non-agent-config platform operations (e.g. admin settings, billing)
